summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Cut It Salon & Spa website. All features working perfectly including navigation, hero section, services with category switching, gallery with hover effects, reviews carousel, contact section with Google Maps, WhatsApp integration, and mobile responsiveness.
passed_tests: Hero section loads with proper background image, heading, and CTA buttons
Navigation bar with smooth scroll links to all sections working
About section displays properly with salon image, text, and animated counters
Services section shows all 5 price categories with proper category switching
Why Choose Us section displays all 4 feature cards with icons
Gallery section shows all 6 images with hover zoom effect
Reviews carousel works with prev/next buttons and displays testimonials
Contact section shows address, phone, opening hours correctly
Google Maps embed loads properly
Get Directions button links correctly
Click-to-call functionality works (tel: link)
Book Appointment buttons link to https://dikidi.app
WhatsApp floating button visible and links to correct number
Mobile menu toggle works on smaller screens
All navigation links scroll smoothly to respective sections
All hover effects work on buttons and cards
Footer displays all business information correctly
Responsive design works on mobile and desktop
Gold color scheme (#D4AF37) consistent throughout
Playfair Display font used for headings, Manrope for body text
